digest.component_or_area: criteria eval CLI and code-review registry integration
propositions: The criteria eval CLI preflight rejects project code-review ids as unknown because it only checks the plan-review registry, blocking activation of code-review criteria before the gate-aware resolver is invoked.
A one-gate project code-review id must be admitted by extending the preflight to check both plan-review and code-review registries and dispatch deterministically to the active gate's calibrate path.

An id active in exactly one gate is admitted and reaches calibration; an id in neither gate returns exit 1 with the existing unknown error; an id in both gates returns exit 1 with a distinct ambiguous error naming both gates.
The criteria eval --help text must include the concrete project code-review example substring project.foo alongside the plan-review example to document the dual-gate admission behavior.
